Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Site options & check-in staging manifest for Redwood / Acme workshop

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the heads up on the Acme Financial workshop (Mar 10-11). Attached is a draft staging plan and our 2nd-floor floorplan showing the preferred arrival flow and an adjacent holding area for VIPs. Highlights: 

- Arrival window: 07:30–09:30 each day; main lobby coned path to loading dock A for vendor drop-off.
- Check-in: 3 stations (two general, one VIP/merchant) with badge printer & card-reader near the north entrance.
- Staging: Room E (adjacent) staged as green room + equipment hold. Power drops at stage left and right; we can run two 20A lines to the staging table.
- Internet: Dedicated wired circuit available; we recommend a bonded LTE backup for the live panel.
- A/V ops: in-house techs available for install; if you prefer a dedicated bridge operator and ISO mix engineer we can recommend AVPros (cc'd contact).

Attachments: floorplan_grandoak_2ndfloor.pdf, AV_SOW_Grandoak.docx
Links: venue walkthrough (video) and DocuSign SOW link below.

Can you confirm final attendee count by EOD Wed and whether Acme requires on-site badge printing and NDA desk? I can pencil in an extra table for secure check-in if needed.

Best,
Anna Ruiz
Director, Events Operations
Grand Oak Conference Center

Anna —

Thanks for the detailed baseline. Quick clarifications so we can finalize with Acme: 

1) Final headcount:

   - Day 2 (Mar 11): 44 attendees + breakout leads
2) Badge printing: Acme wants on-site badge printing with guest photo capture — can you confirm printer model and if you provide consumables?
3) Security: Will there be a secure bag check or NDA table? Acme legal asked about a separate NDA signing station.
4) A/V ops: we will likely engage AVPros for the live remote feed and overflow rooms. Please confirm if your crew will coordinate onsite power distro and whether we should route all cabling through your AV channels.

If you can send a short quote for a dedicated on-site operator (12h day) + rehearsal window (90 minutes before doors), that would be great.

Logan
